caption: Agent Credential Reference
description: A reference to a credential reachable by an executing agent process: identifier, type, and granted scopes only — never the credential material itself. The set of reachable credentials is part of the agent's trust base because it bounds what a compromised or drifted agent could do.
name: agent_credential

4.caption: Delegation Grant
4.description: A signed, scoped delegation credential such as a mandate or attenuable token.

type.description: The credential type, normalized to the caption of the type_id value.

uid.description: The credential reference: a key identifier, token identifier, certificate subject, or grant identifier. Never the credential value.

scopes.description: The scopes or permissions granted to this credential.
